items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I seen him. I seen him.

ctx.x: But I think he's dead. No, Shelly ain't dead.
I don't know if he's still alive. Shelly lives on St. Edna. I know he's dead. He ain't dead. I seen him. I seen him. I was having a mix of somebody else. Shelly ain't dead. I know he's dead.
